title: Water Bath

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Maintains a liquid sample or container at a precise, stable temperature via water as the heating medium — used for tasks such as holding molten agar at a workable temperature before pouring, thawing reagents, or incubating certain reactions.
operatingPrinciple: A heating element and thermostat maintain the water bath at a set temperature; because water has high thermal mass and good heat transfer to immersed containers, it provides more uniform and stable heating than dry heating methods for many applications.
basicOperation: Fill with an appropriate volume of water (or, for some units, another compatible fluid), keeping the level within the manufacturer's marked range.
Set the target temperature and allow the bath to equilibrate before adding samples.
Fully or adequately submerge sample containers as required for even heating, without letting water enter open containers.
calibration: Periodically verify actual water temperature against the display using a calibrated thermometer, since thermostat drift over time can create a gap between set and actual temperature.
maintenance: Change water regularly and clean the basin to prevent microbial growth and mineral buildup.
Check heating elements for scale buildup that can affect heating efficiency.

commonErrors.problem: Bath does not reach or hold set temperature
commonErrors.cause: Low water level, scale buildup on the heating element, or thermostat drift
commonErrors.fix: Refill to the marked level, descale per manufacturer instructions, and verify temperature with a calibrated thermometer
Reduce the number of containers or use a bath with active circulation

safety: Avoid burns from hot water and containers — use appropriate heat-resistant gloves when removing samples.
Keep electrical components away from splashes; use a bath designed and rated for the temperatures in use.
Do not use a standard water bath for flammable solvents unless it is specifically rated for that use.
